method: Exact native term option affix IDs join independently indexed affix_prototype_data rows; each typed attr_id joins the 838-entry generated char-property map. Backward translation pointers bind native affix name/format and multi-attribute term descriptions. Retain source min/max float values and raw byte offsets.
interpretation_gate: These are potential term stat formats and source ranges, not selected roll values or final on-character percentages. Some options list four elemental affix codes under one grouped native description. The generation consumer separately proves uniform range draw and rounding, but item ownership, selected term/affix and combat activation remain unverified.
